details.jd_text:
JOB PURPOSE:

Support corporate communications, especially vaccine related projects (including project coordination, communication, logistics, administrative tasks and other relevant activities)

KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES:

Support project daily coordination and documentation (e.g., drafting key internal documents, keep track of project implementation, taking meetings minutes, scheduling internal meetings, etc.)

Support administrative tasks/processes when needed.

Support relevant communication tasks, including media registration, social media contents creation and daily monitoring.

Support onsite event execution and corporate initiatives when needed.

Support translation tasks when needed.

Willing to work 4 months or longer; 3-5 days a week.

JOB-HOLDER ENTRY REQUIREMENTS:

Education:

Junior undergraduate students and above in Communications, Public Relations, Event Management, Business Management, International Relations, relevant major, or Language related fields

Experience & knowledge:

High interest for healthcare industry and communications

Highly proficient in spoken and written English

Solid graphic/visual design skills: Good knowledge of PowerPoint, Photoshop and other photo/video editing software is a plus

Experience in corporate communications preferred

Core competencies & Profile:

Excellent communication and interpersonal skills

High attention to details and customer expectations- Setting high standards of performance

High sense of responsibility on work assigned

Positive, self-driven, resilient, and reliable

details.job_title: 国际电商运营-实习生-2027届-西语/法语/德语/荷兰语(A01550A)
details.jd_text:
职责描述：
1. 负责国际电商平台的店铺维护、商品上架、页面持续优化
2. 参与平台活动促销的活动方案规划，执行活动配置
3. 店铺销售运营相关的数据运维、分析和报告
4. 参与店铺的流量分析 or 投放
5. 监控商品状态和用户评论情况，改善店铺的订单运营和消费者满意
任职要求：
1、本科及以上学历；有电商实习经验者优先
2、英语6级及以上可用作工作语言，小语种加分
3、具备良好的沟通协调能力，逻辑思维能力强，思维敏捷
4、责任心强，自主性强，目标感强，富有团队精神
5、具备主流办公软件的操作能力
